messages:
Alice M: CI job 'integration/email-sends' is failing on main -> smtp-relay mock returning 500s consistently for last 3 runs. Build: https://ci.internal/builds/12345
Ben K: seeing it too. Fails at SendEmail step with `SMTP 500`.
Caro L: which runner? macOS or linux?
Ben K: macOS runners only so far (two different versions). Linux jobs pass.
Alice M: pinging infra in case there's a platform change. @Riley (SRE) any recent changes to mock-smtp or the relay cluster?
Riley (SRE): we rolled out a proxy update at 04:15 UTC that could affect header size handling. Reverting now as a precaution.
ci-bot: [build 12345] re-run requested by Alice M
Ben K: quick smoke you can run locally: ```curl -v http://mock-smtp.internal:2525/health || telnet mock-smtp.internal 2525``` I get 500 Internal from /health
Caro L: logs show this stack: `SMTPHandler: Error: InvalidHeader -> 500` from mock service. Might be the proxy stripping whitespace.
infra-bot: created incident INC-2026-78 for 'mock-smtp 500s in CI' and attached recent logs.
Alice M: estimate: revert proxy -> rerun -> if green we'll pin proxy config. Ben, can you do a bisect if it stays red after revert?
Ben K: yep, I'll start bisection on the integration tests in the meantime. If revert doesn't fix, suspect a flaky test with header formatting.
Caro L: temporary workaround: set CI env EMAIL_TEST_RETRY=3 and extend timeout. I'll open PR with that and a note to revert once stable.
Alice M: thanks. Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
Riley (SRE): revert in progress, will post when done.
